overview_description.description:
Curri is a construction materials provider that develops a last-mile delivery app that connects supply stores to customers.

The Y Combinator-backed logistics startup company delivers construction supplies and materials with an “Uber-like” last-mile delivery model. App users arrange an order, open the Curri app, and enter pickup and dropoff locations to book the service. Curri’s drivers then pick up the supplies and ensure the order is correct before fulfilling the delivery. It offers live updates via the app to let customers follow and share the status of their deliveries. It also provides proof-of-delivery signatures and photos for tracking, regulatory, and compliance purposes.

The Los Angeles, California-based company was founded in 2018 by Matt Lafferty and Brian Gonzalez.

about_short_description.short_description: Curri is a construction materials provider that develops a last-mile delivery app that connects supply stores to customers.

product.name: Curri Delivery Logistics Platform
product.description: A software platform that manages last-mile and middle-mile delivery logistics for construction and industrial supplies, connecting supply stores to customers.

product.name: Curri Carrier Management
product.description: A centralized software platform for managing carriers, rates, spend, and delivery performance specifically for last-mile delivery in construction and industrial supply sectors.

product.name: Curri Freight
product.description: Freight delivery services offering same-day, expedited, regional, and long-haul options with a variety of vehicle types for industrial shippers.

product.name: Curri Hotshots
product.description: On-demand delivery service for urgent or last-minute construction and industrial supply deliveries using a flexible fleet.

product.name: Curri Dedicated
product.description: Dedicated delivery routes and services for construction and industrial supply chains, supporting both short-term and long-term transportation needs.

product.name: Curri Fleet
product.description: A service providing access to a nationwide fleet of vehicles ranging from sedans to semi-trucks for construction and industrial deliveries.
